user.title: Vehicle Consumption
user.description: Choose the vehicle: its odometer, fuel and battery sensors are looked for on this device.

data_description.device_id: Device of the vehicle's integration (Renault, Tesla, Kia, Volkswagen, OBD dongle…).
data_description.name: Shown on the card and the entities. Leave empty to use the device name.

sensors.title: Sensors of {name}
sensors.description: {found} sensors were found automatically: check them. The odometer is required, plus at least one fuel or battery sensor.

data_description.odometer: Total distance of the vehicle (km or mi).
data_description.fuel_quantity: Fuel left in the tank (L or gal).
data_description.fuel_level: Fuel left in the tank (%). Needs the tank capacity when there is no fuel quantity sensor.
data_description.battery_energy: Energy left in the traction battery (kWh or Wh).
data_description.battery_level: State of charge of the traction battery (%). Needs the battery capacity when there is no battery energy sensor.
data_description.tank_capacity: Turns the fuel level into litres.
data_description.battery_capacity: Turns the battery level into kWh.
data_description.charger_energy: Energy counter of your home charger (evcc, Wallbox, Easee, Zaptec, Ohme…): home charges are measured at the charger, losses included. Needs a battery sensor.

prices.title: Prices for {name}
prices.description: Used to work out the cost of each trip and month. A price sensor (fuel station, electricity tariff) wins over the fixed price; without either, costs are not shown.

data_description.fuel_price_entity: Price per litre (or per gallon) that follows the station prices.
data_description.fuel_price: Price per litre, used when there is no price sensor or it is unavailable.
data_description.electricity_price_entity: Price per kWh of your tariff.
data_description.electricity_price: Price per kWh, used when there is no price sensor or it is unavailable.

error.no_energy_sensor: Choose at least one fuel or battery sensor.
error.tank_capacity_required: The tank capacity is needed to use the fuel level.
error.battery_capacity_required: The battery capacity is needed to use the battery level.
error.charger_needs_battery: A home charger counter needs a battery energy or level sensor.

data_description.charger_energy: Energy counter of your home charger (evcc, Wallbox, Easee, Zaptec, Ohme…): home charges are measured at the charger, losses included. Needs a battery sensor.

prices.title: Prices and detection
prices.description: A price sensor wins over the fixed price. The thresholds tell a refuel or a charge from sensor noise.

data_description.fuel_price_entity: Price per litre (or per gallon) that follows the station prices.
data_description.fuel_price: Price per litre, used when there is no price sensor or it is unavailable.
data_description.electricity_price_entity: Price per kWh of your tariff.
data_description.electricity_price: Price per kWh, used when there is no price sensor or it is unavailable.
data_description.trip_gap: A trip ends when the odometer has not moved for this long.
data_description.refuel_threshold: A fuel rise of at least this much is a refuel; smaller rises are ignored.
data_description.charge_threshold: A battery rise of at least this much is a charge; smaller rises are ignored.

add_refuel.name: Add a refuel
add_refuel.description: Logs a refuel by hand. It is listed with the detected ones; the consumption keeps coming from the sensors.

cost.name: Total cost
cost.description: Amount paid. Worked out from the price when left out.

price.name: Price per litre
price.description: Worked out from the total cost when left out; the current price when both are.

odometer.name: Odometer
odometer.description: Odometer reading (km). The last known reading when left out.

add_charge.name: Add a charge
add_charge.description: Logs a charge by hand. It is listed with the detected ones; the consumption keeps coming from the sensors.

cost.name: Total cost
cost.description: Amount paid. Worked out from the price when left out.

price.name: Price per kWh
price.description: Worked out from the total cost when left out; the current price when both are.

odometer.name: Odometer
odometer.description: Odometer reading (km). The last known reading when left out.

reset_statistics.name: Reset statistics
reset_statistics.description: Clears the trips, months, refuels, charges and totals of the vehicle; tracking starts again from the current readings.

config_entry_id.name: Vehicle
config_entry_id.description: The vehicle whose statistics are cleared.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Rebuilds the trips, months, refuels and charges of the vehicle from what Home Assistant recorded of its sensors (as far back as the recorder keeps it). Manual refuels and charges are kept.

config_entry_id.name: Vehicle
config_entry_id.description: The vehicle whose history is imported.
